title: bug: Linux multipass-snap prerequisite rejects a refresh-held snap, so pinning 1.17.0 with `snap refresh --hold` fails prerequisites and certify
description:
governor-693b7073 found this at 18:20Z while running R13's Linux certification on the operator's WSL2 host, at commit 3f87ff37 (snapshot ~/moe-certify-src).

Evidence:
- The operator installed the snap and pinned it: `sudo snap install multipass && sudo snap refresh --hold multipass`.
- `snap list multipass --unicode=never --color=never` then prints `multipass  1.17.0  19760  latest/stable  canonical**  held`.
- `cli.mjs prerequisites` exits 2. Every item is satisfied (KVM, interfaces, authenticated, driver qemu, resources, cache) except `multipass-snap`, with the action "Install the Multipass 1.17.0 snap from the verified Canonical publisher with strict confinement (requires sudo)."
- Cause: probeSnap (scripts/local-runner/platform-linux.mjs:58-66) requires `notes === '-'`. Its comment treats every note as weaker confinement or an inactive snap. But `held` is snapd's refresh hold: it is neither a confinement mode nor an inactive snap.

Why it matters:
- certified-provider.json pins versions ["1.17.0"], and 1.17.1 is already in the candidate channel.
- A refresh hold is the natural way to keep the certified version when 1.17.1 reaches stable. Today it fails closed, and the action text sends the operator to reinstall a snap that is already correct.
- The workaround is `sudo snap refresh --unhold multipass`.

Fix:
- Accept a Notes column that is `-` or contains only `held` (snapd comma-separates notes).
- Keep rejecting every other note (devmode, classic, jailmode, try, disabled, broken), alone or combined with `held`.
- Update the probeSnap comment.
- In docs/CERTIFICATION.md "How to run it" step 1, say that a refresh hold is allowed and keeps 1.17.0.

It depends on R13 because R13 holds scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs and docs/CERTIFICATION.md.
definitionOfDone: probeSnap is satisfied for notes `-` and `held`. Any other note, alone or combined with `held` (e.g. `disabled,held`, `devmode`), stays unsatisfied with the existing action text.
A local-runner test covers `held` (satisfied), `held` combined with a weakening note (unsatisfied), and the existing rejected notes.
docs/CERTIFICATION.md says a `snap refresh --hold multipass` pin is allowed and keeps the certified 1.17.0.
`node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs` exits 0 in a snapshot, never in the shared checkout, and its output is supplied to complete_task.

implementationPlan.description:
Minimum implementation (GREEN) and docs.
(a) scripts/local-runner/platform-linux.mjs probeSnap (:58-66): accept exactly `-` or exactly `held`. For example, keep the existing return and replace `notes === '-'` with `(notes === '-' || notes === 'held')`; a frozen two-entry Set is fine too. Do NOT split on commas: `held` combined with any other note (devmode, classic, jailmode, try, disabled, broken) stays false, as does any unknown note. Rewrite the comment above it: `-` is a plain strictly confined snap; `held` is only snapd's refresh hold (`snap refresh --hold multipass`), which keeps the certified 1.17.0 and changes no confinement or activation; every other note, alone or with `held`, is weaker confinement or an inactive snap.
Error handling is unchanged and fails closed. A missing snap is still false. An unreadable, oversized or misshapen table, or zero or several rows, is still null (unknown). Any other note is still false with the existing SNAP_ACTION text. Nothing else in platform-linux.mjs changes (the snapTable parser, the item order, the actions, missingPlugs).
(b) docs/CERTIFICATION.md '## How to run it' step 1 (:37-40): add one or two sentences. On Linux a refresh hold (`sudo snap refresh --hold multipass`) is allowed and keeps the certified 1.17.0 when a newer Multipass reaches the stable channel; `snap list multipass` then shows the note `held`. Any other note, alone or with `held` (devmode, classic, jailmode, try, disabled, broken), fails the `multipass-snap` item. Keep the existing wording and R13's Certified platforms table untouched.
Re-run the focused snapshot test from step 1 and record GREEN.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN in snapshot. probeSnap accepts exactly '-' or 'held'; docs step 1 updated.
